project_comments.note: Synthesis complete. All 8 WPs delivered with 933/933 server tests and 42 GUI tests passing. Three strategic insights worth preserving: (1) the event-log state-machine pattern for stale-badge resolution (write a 'info' success entry to suppress stale 'error' entries via newest-first Set dedup) is a reusable idiom for any health check that resolves via a subsequent success operation; (2) CSS design token aliasing via var() correctly propagates dark-mode overrides without duplicate declarations — should be the standard pattern for semantic badge variants; (3) Fix-Forward as a first-class Reviewer action (3 applied this cycle) keeps small non-behavioral improvements out of rework queues. One medium-priority deferred item: WP-002 trim-before-length-check spec gap in parseGitCredentials() (validates trimmed length, not raw) — low risk but should be aligned in the next cycle.

outcome_summary: All 8 work packages in the multi-credential-support-rework-2 cycle were completed successfully, closing the final deferred items from the rework-1 synthesis: ErrorSeverity expanded to 'error'|'warning'|'audit'|'info', credential audit entries migrated to Severity:'audit', parseGitCredentials() normalized to trim all fields at parse time, a shared MockErrorLogManager test helper extracted, stale credential badges resolved via success log entries and checkWorkspaceHealth() suppression logic, a "Configure Credential" health alert button added, CSS credential badge design tokens unified, and a cross-cutting documentation audit completed. The project ended at 933 passing server tests and 42 passing GUI view tests with 0 TypeScript errors and 0 security findings.
